artifact_description: Deterministic fixture generated from committed harness source code and Phase 23L smoke proof acceptance. This artifact documents the harness field-mapping logic that maps Deribit book channel fields to DeribitPublicWsSmokeEvent fields. It is NOT a live parse-sequence record — no actual integer values from a live Deribit session are committed in this artifact. The smoke proof (Phase 23L, run_id=25671516104) established accepted=true, message_count=19, rejection_reasons=[] but did not commit individual message field values. This artifact bridges that gap by documenting the deterministic mapping code that was exercised in that smoke run.

smoke_proof_reference.note: Smoke proof confirms the harness successfully received and processed 19 messages with no rejections. Field-level values were NOT committed to the repo in that run.

change_id_to_sequence_id.harness_logic: Reads data.get('change_id') first; falls back to data.get('sequence') then data.get('seq'); returns None if none found or value < 0

prev_change_id_to_prev_sequence_id.harness_logic: Reads data.get('prev_change_id') first; falls back to data.get('prev_sequence') then data.get('prev_seq'); returns None if none found or value < 0
prev_change_id_to_prev_sequence_id.test_coverage_reference: tests/crypto_core/data/test_phase23b_deribit_public_ws_harness.py::test_sequence_gap_rejects_when_sequence_fields_exist — uses fixture with prev_change_id=9 and change_id=12 to verify sequence-gap detection via prev_sequence_id

payload_kind_from_type.harness_logic: Returns data.get('type') if it is a non-empty string; otherwise returns 'market_data'
payload_kind_from_type.fixture_note: Test fixture in test_phase23b uses type='snapshot' in _subscription_payload helper. However, this is a test-fixture value — not an actual observed Deribit server response. The smoke run did not commit the type field values of the 19 received messages.

continuity_condition_via_sequence_gap_ch.harness_logic: In _event_from_payload, if prev_sequence_id is not None and prev_sequence_id != last_sequence_by_channel[channel], a deribit_ws:sequence_gap rejection reason is added. This implements the continuity check: prev_change_id[n] must equal change_id[n-1].
continuity_condition_via_sequence_gap_ch.fixture_note: The continuity logic is committed code with test coverage (test_sequence_gap_rejects). But no committed artifact proves this continuity held across 19 actual received messages in the smoke run — individual message field values were not committed.

change_id.rationale: Harness code design is advisory only. _sequence_id_from_data() reads data.get('change_id'), but this is committed code mapping logic — not evidence that actual Deribit server messages contain this field. Test fixture uses change_id=10 (synthetic fixture value, not observed from Deribit). Smoke run (Phase 23L, accepted=true, 19 messages, 0 rejections) confirms the harness code path ran without error but field-level integer values were NOT committed to the repo. Same standard applied in Phase 25K Codex P2 review. Classification: WAIT_INSUFFICIENT — requires a committed parse-sequence fixture recording actual observed change_id integer values from a real Deribit server response.

prev_change_id.rationale: Harness code design is advisory only. _prev_sequence_id_from_data() reads data.get('prev_change_id'), but this is committed code mapping logic — not evidence that actual Deribit server messages contain this field. Test fixture uses prev_change_id=9 (synthetic fixture value, not observed from Deribit). Smoke run (Phase 23L, accepted=true, 19 messages, 0 rejections) confirms the harness ran without error but field-level values were NOT committed. Same standard applied in Phase 25K Codex P2 review. Classification: WAIT_INSUFFICIENT — requires a committed parse-sequence fixture recording actual observed prev_change_id integer values from a real Deribit server response.

first_message_snapshot.rationale: No committed artifact records an actual observed type='snapshot' value from a real Deribit book channel message. The harness _payload_kind() function is designed to read the type field, and test fixtures use type='snapshot', but these are fixture values not live observations. The smoke run's 19 messages were accepted but their type field values are not committed to this repo.

incremental_delta.rationale: No committed artifact records an actual observed type='change' value from a real Deribit book channel message. Same gap as first_message_snapshot — harness design and test fixtures exist but no live message field values are committed.

continuity_condition.rationale: No committed artifact proves prev_change_id[n] == change_id[n-1] across an actual observed message sequence. The harness implements the check and the test fixture proves it catches violations, but no record of the 19 smoke run messages' change_id/prev_change_id values is committed.

observed_values_note: No actual Deribit server message field values (change_id integers, type string values, prev_change_id integers) are committed in this artifact. The smoke proof aggregates (accepted, message_count, rejection_reasons) are committed in DERIBIT_PUBLIC_SMOKE_PROOF_RECORD.md but individual event samples were not captured to a committed file.
next_required_artifact: A committed parse-sequence fixture recording actual observed type, change_id, and prev_change_id values from a real Deribit book channel message sequence is required to promote change_id, prev_change_id, first_message_snapshot, incremental_delta, and continuity_condition from WAIT_INSUFFICIENT to PROOF_READY_NOT_APPROVED. This artifact contains only harness mapping capability evidence — not live observed field values.
